extra_quotes: Cross-sectional and surface pore morphologies were obtained by scanning electron microscopy (SEM, Zeiss Gemini 300) using secondary electron (SE) imaging.
ECE was carried out on a Gamry Reference 3000 potentiostat connected to a three -electrode electrochemical cell containing a Pt plate CE and 3 M Ag/AgCl RE.

Plan-view SE images of the bulk (i.e., subsurface) pore morphologies were recorded by removing the uppermost 500 nm of the 1 μm-thick porous GaN layer using an analogous FIB arrangement as that used by Thornley et al.
No direct evidence of the ECE mechanism is obtained in this study.

The mechanistic interpretation proposed here is therefore necessarily speculative and is based on consistent trends observed across a broad range of ECE conditions, rather than on direct measurement of the proposed mechanistic processes.
